# YeahSight

> YeahSight gives a clear, structured view of how society works and where it is heading. It covers four domains: environment & energy, economy & equity, technology & automation, and social organization, and ends with a proposed roadmap for society. YeahSight is an initiative of HappyBein, a Dutch foundation (Stichting) based in Eindhoven whose idea is that structured understanding unlocks solutions. All articles are available in English and French.

## Start here

- [Foresight Trends](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/foresight-trends/): what foresight is and an overview of all trend areas
- [Vision & Roadmap](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/vision-roadmap/): the six proposed steps towards a fairer, safer world

## Environment & Energy

- [Land per Person](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/forces/land-per-person/): global land use broken down per person
- [Fair Space Sharing](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/sharing-fairly/fair-space-sharing/): a proposal for sharing land between humans and wildlife
- [Clean & Safe Energy](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/forces/clean-safe-energy/): energy sources compared, and the path to renewables
- [Plant-Based Consumption](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/forces/plant-based-consumption/): how diet connects to land, climate and animal welfare

## Economy & Equity

- [Universal Allowance](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/sharing-fairly/universal-allowance/): a guaranteed, purpose-bound budget for basic needs
- [The Economic System](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/how-society-works/economic-system/): how economic systems work and shape outcomes
- [Fair Globe Sharing](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/sharing-fairly/fair-globe-sharing/): what a fair distribution of the world's resources could look like
- [Inheritance](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/sharing-fairly/inheritance/): how inheritance carries inequity forward, and a proposal for redistribution
- [Making the Transition](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/sharing-fairly/making-the-transition/): a proposed step-by-step path from inherited financial unfairness to a fair and sustainable society, including how countries can go first without losing out
